name: repo-build-checklist
description: A 400-item checklist for building a software repository from empty directory to maintained project. Filter by phase, priority, and applies_to; running all 400 on a small project is the wrong use.

usage.filter_by_priority: must = do it or accept known risk; should = default yes; optional = context-dependent
usage.filter_by_applies_to: Match against your project type tags before treating an item as relevant
usage.minimum_viable_pass: The 'must' items alone are a defensible baseline for a small project
usage.done_field: Mutable boolean, provided so this file can be used as working state

phases.title: Performance
phases.when: After it works, before it scales

phases.title: API design
phases.when: If the project exposes an interface

phases.title: Frontend & accessibility
phases.when: If the project has a UI
